5      Health Connect READ_/WRITE_ permissions for individual variables, the
6      background-job permission set, and the read-history permission are all
7      added dynamically by the capacitor:sync:after hook instead of declared
8      here - the background-job and read-history groups are each optional
9      (disableBackgroundJobs / disableReadHealthDataHistory), matching the
10      Cordova plugin's DisableBackgroundJobs / DisableReadHealthDataHistory
11      preferences, and Android manifest merging has no equivalent conditional
12      mechanism for a plugin's own static declarations. See android/NOTES.md.
13    -->
